seo_title: BI & Analytics Platform — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Sense, simulate, act — the operations stack for physical assets.

blocks.x: BI & Analytics Platform — Overview delivered as an operating capability for the enterprise, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.

BI & Analytics Platform bridges sensor network to decisions: governed telemetry (OPC UA/Sparkplug) from retrofit-friendly devices, physics+data digital twins with validated models, edge inference fleets with OTA, predictive maintenance wired into CMMS work orders, and the scenario engines planners actually use.

blocks.title: BI & Analytics Platform — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: Signals, context and policy converge at the decision layer; every scored decision is logged with its inputs so it can be replayed at audit.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind BI & Analytics Platform — Overview is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

Twinverse is built for brownfield reality: non-invasive mounting, protocol translation from fieldbuses, offline-first edge patterns, and calibration discipline. Twins ship with the decisions they must improve and the baseline they must beat — a decision instrument, not a 3D screenshot.

items: Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.
Spend per query attributed to the team that wrote it — the meter everyone can see.
Batch windows measured against the plan every run — the number reported is the observed one.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
Evidence generated as a by-product of doing the work — audit readiness stops being a season.
The program draws on the pattern library where it fits and departs from it where your estate says otherwise.
Decision ownership named per metric — the org chart and the system agree on who answers.

blocks.x: Certified integration surface: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters.
